events.title: RADZIMA DEMO - UPDATE for the Steam NEXT FEST
events.summary: Hello Brothers and Sisters!We've been listening to your feedback after playing our demo, and we've just released a new update to make your experience a little more forgiving!Here's what's changed:Monsters are now a bit easier to outsmart! They get slower over time, are more likely to give up chasing you, and won't always land their attacks. You'll have more chances to escape and outsmart them.We've reduced the number of monsters on levels -2 to 2, giving you a bit more breathing room.Our demo is

events.title: SIGN UP for the PLAYTESTS!
events.summary: Hello Brothers and Sisters!We have great news - you can now sign up for the RADZIMA playtests!How to join? Go to our Steam page and click 'Request Access.' That’s it!When will the playtests start? After sign-ups close, you will get an email invitation. So keep an eye on your inbox!

events.title: RADZIMA DEMO - HOTFIX
events.summary: Hello Brothers and Sisters!We’ve just published another hotfix for our demo!Level 1 has been made easier, based on player feedbackNPCs are now slightly less sensitive to voice and footstep soundsSee you in the game!

events.title: RADZIMA DEMO - HOTFIX
events.summary: Hello Brothers and Sisters!We’ve just released another hotfix for our demo!This update includes:Network usage optimizationsVoice chat improvementsSee you in the game!

events.title: RADZIMA DEMO - HOTFIX - Connecting to other regions FIXED
events.summary: Hello Brothers and Sisters!We've just made the hotfix to our demo - connecting to other regions is FIXED now.You can now play with friends from other regions! The game will use the host's region.PS. Sorry about this issue - it's our first co-op game!PS. 2. Remember, it’s worth making sure you have the latest version of the game by verifying the game files on Steam.

events.title: RADZIMA DEMO IS OUT NOW!
events.summary: Hello Brothers and Sisters!The RADZIMA Demo is OUT NOW on Steam!PLAY THE DEMO NOWRADZIMA is a 1–4 player co-op survival horror set in an underground research facility. Find radioactive items, avoid the mutants, and power the elevator reactor to descend deeper - all in service of the Party’s will.The demo will be available for a limited time only - until RADZIMA launches in Early Access - which is coming soon.Have fun!
